full_judgment: 8. The trial Court rejected the plaintiffs claim in the suit property by virtue of a deed of agreement for sale on the ground that such claim has become time barred as three years have elapsed from the date of execution of the said deed. The learned Subordinate Judge is wrong. The cause of action for a suit for specific performance of contract arises when the person who executes the deed of agreement for sale refuses to act in accordance with the terms of the said agreement. Therefore, unless such occasion arises the period of limitation for such a suit does not start.
